purpose: Operational parameter selection on disjoint development families; not final RAG quality evaluation
cluster_selection: Among nondegenerate candidates with every cluster at least 2 chunks for all seeds: highest mean cosine silhouette, then mean between-seed adjusted Rand index, then smaller cluster count. This is an unsupervised heuristic, not validated thematic quality.
top_k_selection: Largest candidate whose complete hits fit the same character budget for both methods on every development query; no method-specific tuning.
generation_gate: Check complete replies, citation IDs, product attribution and prompt plus output token counts locally before final configuration freeze. If output truncates, revise on development only.

queries.question: What negative experiences with scent do these reviews describe? Attribute each finding to the relevant product group, cite evidence, and do not make medical conclusions.
What packaging or dispensing problems are reported? Attribute findings to product groups and cite evidence. Do not assume who caused damage.
What limitations in performance or useful life are reported? Keep the product groups and different duration concepts separate. Cite evidence.
Which valued characteristics should be considered when planning improvements? Attribute findings to product groups and cite evidence.

What physical or functional product or packaging improvements could be investigated from the reported problems? Separate evidence, proposed improvement and what needs validation. Attribute each proposal to a product group and cite its supporting evidence.
Do these reviews establish which product change would increase sales? Explain the limits of the evidence without inventing a causal forecast.

development_refinement: Development-only probes led to an explicit per-group structured output contract and a shared top-k cap of 8. Raw failures are retained; no evaluation answers or reference metrics used.
